prompt:
Explain what this Renyi program does in at most three sentences, for a reader who will decide whether to use it. Do not quote code.

module file_tree
  purpose: Print a directory tree with the size of every file and folder in bytes.

import std.console
import std.environment
import std.filesystem exposing Path, Entry, FileError

public function total_size(path: Path) returns Integer or fails with FileError needs filesystem.read
  purpose: The size of a file, or the sum of the sizes of everything under a directory.
  tags: filesystem, recursion

  let entry be filesystem.inspect(path) otherwise fail
  match entry
    when File(size) then return size
    when Directory then
      let children be filesystem.list(path) otherwise fail
      return for each child in children sum total_size(child) otherwise fail
    when Other then return 0
  end
end

public function print_tree(path: Path, depth: Integer)
  or fails with FileError
  needs console, filesystem.read
  purpose: Print the entry at the path and, for a directory, every child one level deeper.

  let indent be "  ".repeat(depth)
  let size be total_size(path) otherwise fail
  console.print("{indent}{path.name()} ({size} bytes)")
  let entry be filesystem.inspect(path) otherwise fail
  if entry is not Directory then return end
  let children be filesystem.list(path) otherwise fail
  for each child in children sorted by child.name()
    print_tree(path: child, depth: depth + 1) otherwise fail
  end
end

public function main() or fails with FileError needs console, environment, filesystem.read
  purpose: Print the tree of the directory named on the command line, or of the current one.

  let root be environment.arguments().first() otherwise "."
  print_tree(path: Path(root), depth: 0) otherwise fail
end
